answer: Edge-Overlap Attestation lets agents earn trust only when their transaction graph overlaps verified neighbors. Every new identity must anchor into a vault of witnessed interactions before gaining routing priority. An attacker must sustain a harbor of distinct, mutually-observed counterparties per fake node, paying real compute and latency to keep each one alive. The violet flag marks clusters whose internal edges never cross verified boundaries, and isolating one fake identity costs roughly the compute of twenty real transactions plus ongoing traffic upkeep.
